title: Abbey Road, London
fact: A white Volkswagen sits beside the Abbey Road crossing, photographed just weeks after the Beatles made it famous.
creator: Dr. Ronald Kunze

title: Throgmorton Street, London
fact: London’s financial district spills into the street outside the Stock Exchange on a summer day.
creator: Ben Brooksbank

title: Mary Jackson at NASA Langley
fact: Mary Jackson became NASA’s first Black woman engineer in 1958. Here she is, nearly two decades later, at work in Langley’s research center.
creator: NASA

title: The Berlin Wall, opened
fact: Border police stand beside a breach in the Berlin Wall, with the Brandenburg Gate just beyond it.
creator: Stefan Richter

title: A street in Papeete, Tahiti
fact: Look closely: this quiet Pacific street already has a telephone bureau and an electrician’s shop.
creator: Henry Winkelmann

title: The amphibious Cyclomer, Paris
fact: The Cyclomer was a bicycle built for both land and water, designed to carry up to 120 kilograms.
creator: Unknown photographer / Nationaal Archief, Spaarnestad Photo

title: A cameraman on Tokyo Bay
fact: A movie cameraman frames Tokyo Bay, with Tokyo Tower rising in the background.
creator: József Csőke / Fortepan

title: Rue de l’Abreuvoir, Paris
fact: A quiet bend in Montmartre’s Rue de l’Abreuvoir, preserved in the Musée Carnavalet’s Paris archive.
creator: R. Auvillain / Musée Carnavalet

title: Grand Central Terminal, New York
fact: Grand Central Terminal in its opening year, with horse-drawn traffic still moving along 42nd Street.
creator: Unknown photographer / Frances Loeb Library, Harvard

title: Hietalahti, Helsinki
fact: Helsinki’s Hietalahti waterfront seen from above: shipyards, apartment blocks and working docks in one frame.
creator: Sky-Foto Möller / Helsinki City Museum

title: Duke Ellington and his band, New York
fact: Duke Ellington and his musicians crowd around a piano at New York’s Aquarium jazz club.
creator: William P. Gottlieb / Library of Congress

title: Buzz Aldrin on the Moon
fact: The photographer is in the picture too: Neil Armstrong is reflected in Buzz Aldrin’s visor.
creator: Neil Armstrong / NASA

title: The Wright brothers’ first flight
fact: Orville is at the controls while Wilbur runs alongside. John T. Daniels squeezed the camera’s shutter bulb.
creator: John T. Daniels; restoration by Wikimedia user Wright Stuf

title: Pike and Henry Streets, New York
fact: Berenice Abbott used the Manhattan Bridge to frame an ordinary day on the Lower East Side.
creator: Berenice Abbott / New York Public Library

title: Freight cars at Chicago’s Proviso yard
fact: This is real period color: Jack Delano photographed freight cars being moved around Chicago’s Proviso rail yard.
creator: Jack Delano / Library of Congress

title: Ripple Road, Barking
fact: A red double-decker shares Ripple Road with everyday traffic in east London.
creator: Alan Murray-Rust

title: Tiananmen Square, Beijing
fact: Tourists cross Tiananmen Square in a photograph made on a Zenit-E film camera.
creator: Derzsi Elekes Andor

title: An afternoon in New York
fact: John Atherton’s street photograph turns an ordinary New York afternoon into a time capsule of everyday style.
creator: John Atherton

title: A roadside stop in Oregon
fact: The car is a 1960 Austin-Healey Sprite; the photograph came six years later, on an Oregon road trip.
creator: John Atherton

title: On the boardwalk at Deauville
fact: A patterned dress and matching headwear on Deauville’s boardwalk, captured by the Rol press agency.
creator: Agence Rol / Bibliothèque nationale de France

title: Auto-rickshaws on an Indian street
fact: Three-wheeled taxis line up on an Indian street—a familiar everyday scene, photographed a decade before its Wikipedia upload.
creator: Gaius Cornelius

title: Traffic in Accra, Ghana
fact: Taxis and minibuses fill an Accra road, turning everyday traffic into a bright portrait of Ghana’s capital.
creator: Francisco Anzola

title: Working beside Mombasa’s airport
fact: A C-130 stops to refuel while workers cut the grass around the taxiways at Mombasa’s Moi International Airport.
creator: SRA Andy Dunaway / U.S. Air Force

title: The original iPhone
fact: The original iPhone, photographed just weeks after it first went on sale. One home button was still the whole idea.
creator: Aido2002

title: Atlantis launches for the last time
fact: NASA’s final shuttle launch, seen through the window of a Shuttle Training Aircraft flying nearby.
creator: Dick Clark / NASA

title: Curiosity gets a weather station
fact: A technician fits Curiosity’s weather sensors in a clean room. The rover’s tiny weather station was supplied by Spain.
creator: NASA / JPL-Caltech
